coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Five of nine ground-truth variable categories match (56%): the required LLaMA-2 model sizes, weight precisions, four quantization methods, WikiText-2 perplexity, and Inf/NaN stability monitoring are included. The four constant-variable specifications are only partially matched or contradicted.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design allows FP16/BF16 activations and baselines instead of fixing FP16, and does not explicitly fix KV caches to FP16. It varies grouping and symmetric/asymmetric quantization instead of holding per-column asymmetric quantization constant. It expands evaluation beyond the fixed WikiText-2/2048 setting to C4 and other benchmarks. Additional architectures, methods, and diagnostic metrics also broaden the experiment beyond the reference design.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it cannot semantically match the ground-truth results.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion or results were supplied, including the low-bit improvements from QuaRot-GPTQ, RTN failures, partial RTN stabilization, and the 70B W2 perplexity reduction from 25.30 to 5.60.
